description: This file defines functions for classifying, parsing, and formatting network port listeners and diagnostics, specifically for handling port-related logic such as identifying gateways, SSH tunnels, and loopback addresses.

methods.name: classifyPortListener
methods.description: Classifies a port listener as 'gateway', 'ssh', or 'unknown' based on its command line and port.

methods.name: parseListenerAddress
methods.description: Parses a listener address string into host and port components.

methods.name: classifyLoopbackAddressFamily
methods.description: Determines if a host string corresponds to IPv4 or IPv6 loopback addresses.

methods.name: isDualStackLoopbackGatewayListeners
methods.description: Checks if a set of listeners form a dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) gateway on the same port and process.

methods.name: buildPortHints
methods.description: Generates user hints based on current listeners on a port, such as existing gateways or SSH tunnels.

methods.name: formatPortListener
methods.description: Formats a port listener object into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatPortDiagnostics
methods.description: Creates diagnostic messages about port usage, including current listeners and hints.
